# Correlated address bounds

A helper receives an address, a capacity that fits its address range, and a smaller requested count. It proves the requested offset fits before computing it, then promises the exact mathematical result. Two distinct calls must return 4113 and 8217; either wrong result traps. All four hosted entries are declared and the expected exit is 0.

The [negative twin](../../../fail/arithmetic/correlated_addr_bounds/main.omg) removes only the incoming capacity-fit premise. Its endpoint identity must not justify forming the addition. The refusal must name operation safety for local `endpoint`.

This is a prerequisite for the unchanged generic Run/Vec program. It does not establish content conservation or Run custody. Governing rules: [counts and addresses](../../../../../wiki/spec/language/counts_and_addresses.md), [proof contracts](../../../../../wiki/spec/proofs/contracts.md) and [integer certificates](../../../../../wiki/spec/terminal-psi/integer_certificates.md).
